items.case: A message refused for its header
items.text: refused message 3: control character in name
items.note: Contract 0.6.0 SDK adoption r8, TO-7. One line for each message refused for its header, the first time it is recorded. No sender and no header content. The log has no x-output home; it stays in spec/next.json until the spec is closed for 0.6.0.

Contract 0.6.0 SDK adoption r8, TO-2: one entry of the structured result, which is exactly the object `mash inbox --json` prints (see the inbox `--json, a refused entry` case). The object gains "refused": 1, always present, 0 when none. Stays in spec/next.json until W writes the tool entries in spec/mash-mcp.json, and moves there.
